$description: Button colors for the design file's ten Button variants, synced by npm run figcraft:tokens. They live here, not only in the design file, so the repo stays the source. Two tiers: `core` holds the seven plain references, the same in both modes — NOT under the color.* prefix, because the design file's bindings name them button.* ($penpotCoreSet only matters to the frozen Penpot export). `themes` holds the nine genuine color-mix() results from src/assets/css/local/button.css, flattened per theme, so those hexes drift if the palette moves. All nine still clear AA.
